nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file for the toggle-group UI component, re-exporting the Root/Item primitives under both short and descriptive aliases for import ergonomics.
nodes.languageNotes: shadcn-svelte style barrel exposing both `Root`/`Item` and `ToggleGroup`/`ToggleGroupItem` aliases.

nodes.name: toggle-group.svelte
nodes.summary: Toggle-group root component wrapping the bits-ui ToggleGroup primitive; establishes a Svelte context carrying variant, size, spacing, and orientation for child items.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Svelte `module` script to expose set/get context helpers and Svelte 5 runes (`$props`, `$bindable`) with getter-based reactive context props.

nodes.name: toggle-group-item.svelte
nodes.summary: Individual toggle-group item wrapping the bits-ui ToggleGroup.Item primitive; reads variant/size/spacing from the group context to derive its styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Consumes group context via `getToggleGroupCtx` and composes toggleVariants classes with `cn`.
